messages.subject: Proposal: protected focus time on Wednesdays
messages.body:
Hi all,

A small experiment I would like to float: making Wednesdays meeting-free across the company. No internal meetings, no stand-ups moved there, no 'quick syncs'. Focus blocks are the single most requested item in the last two pulse surveys, and a protected day is the simplest version of them.

Practical bits:
- Customer-facing calls with clients in other time zones can still happen - this is about internal meetings only
- Existing recurring Wednesday meetings (the product review) would move to Thursday
- We could try it for a defined period and check in on how it feels, rather than treating it as permanent

Marta, I realise this touches everyone's calendar, so I would like your view before I propose anything more concretely.

Warm regards,
Ingrid Solberg
People & Culture, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Proposal: protected focus time on Wednesdays
messages.body:
Hola Ingrid,

Concern from my side: Wednesday is prime demo day. Redline, Swiftbox and two prospects currently have calls on Wednesday afternoons, and Samir and I plan our week around them. If 'no internal meetings' also means no internal prep sessions before client calls, that part I can live with ✅. But if anyone later decides it should block client calls too, sales will revolt 🚀

As long as the scope is internal-only, I think it's worth trying!

Saludos,
Tomás

messages.subject: RE: Proposal: protected focus time on Wednesdays
messages.body:
Quick recap of my view:

1. Support from me, with Tomás's caveat respected - internal only, client calls stay where they are
2. The Thursday product review move is easy, I have already looked at calendars
3. Jonas will be pleased, he has been asking for this since roughly forever

Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: RE: Proposal: protected focus time on Wednesdays
messages.body:
ok let's try it for a few weeks. internal only, tomás's client calls untouched.

M

messages.subject: RE: Proposal: protected focus time on Wednesdays
messages.body:
Liebe Alle,

I'll update the calendars this afternoon:
- recurring meetings currently on Wednesdays move to Thursday (product review goes to Thursday 10:00)
- I'll block Wednesday as 'focus day' so nobody books over it by accident
- trial period: we review how it's working at the leadership meeting in a few weeks

Danke,
Lena
